title: 第5章 护身符第6章 土匪官兵齐聚
content_zh:
d就在他摸索刀疤男身体时，摸出来一块碧绿色的玉佩。
之所以感觉奇怪，是因为他在上面感受到了灵气波动。
与灵石的波动不同，这玉佩里面的能量好像是按照某种规律运转。
他试着运转呼吸吐纳法进行吸收，可是并没有将里面的能量吸出来。
“这是什么东西？”
江平安搞不懂。
掏出一块灵石与这块玉佩进行比较。
就在两者碰在一起的时候，灵石上的能量迅速被抽空，化作粉末。
江平安吓得大惊失色，下意识地将玉佩丢了出去。
看着粉碎的灵石，江平安格外心疼。
每天才能复制十颗，就这么没了一颗？
这玉佩到底是什么？
蹲在玉佩旁边，用木棍戳了戳，什么都没发生。
重新将玉佩捡起，江平安发现玉佩里的能量多出了很多，里面的能量依旧按照一定的规律运转。
“这到底是个啥？”
江平安想找人问问，可是周围没有人，只有尸体。
这时，他注意到了玉佩后面有三个字，护身符。
“难道也是仙人的宝物，能保护身体？”
想到上面有能量波动，这与自己用的能量差不多，或许真是什么仙人宝物。
江平安觉得自己想对了。

“之前不能保护刀疤男，很可能是因为护身符里面的能量用完了。”
想到这东西有保护作用，江平安咬了咬牙，又贴了两块灵石到附近。
灵石能量被消耗光，可玉佩好像还没吸满的样子。
江平安剩下的灵石不多了，所以从自己身上往玉佩里注入能量。
但将体内全部能量灌入其中，依旧没有灌满。
“无底洞啊！”
江平安格外心疼。
还是从天地之间吸收能量慢慢灌吧，反正也不着急。
就在这时，外面突然传来动静。
江平安猛地拿起刀冲了出去，一道人影正在极速逃跑。
他赶紧提刀追去。
很可能是土匪同伙！
绝不能让对方跑掉！
但是追了好一会儿，江平安还是追丢了。
content_en:
d Just as he was groping for the scarred man's body, he pulled out a green jade pendant.
The reason why it felt strange was that he felt the spiritual energy fluctuations on it.
Different from the fluctuations of spiritual stones, the energy in this jade pendant seems to operate according to certain rules.
He tried to use the breathing method to absorb it, but the energy inside was not sucked out.
"What is this?"
Jiang Ping'an couldn't understand.
Take out a spiritual stone and compare it with this jade pendant.
When the two touched each other, the energy on the spirit stone was quickly drained and turned into powder.
Jiang Ping'an was so frightened that he threw the jade pendant away subconsciously.
Looking at the shattered spirit stone, Jiang Ping'an felt particularly distressed.
Only ten can be copied every day, so one is gone?
What exactly is this jade pendant?
I squatted next to the jade pendant and poked it with a wooden stick, but nothing happened.
Picking up the jade pendant again, Jiang Pingan found that the jade pendant had a lot more energy, and the energy inside still operated according to certain rules.
"What the hell is this?"
Jiang Pingan wanted to find someone to ask, but there was no one around, only corpses.
At this time, he noticed three words behind the jade pendant, amulet.
"Is it also a treasure of an immortal that can protect the body?"
I thought that there were energy fluctuations on it, which was similar to the energy I used. Maybe it was really some kind of immortal treasure.
Jiang Pingan felt that he was right.
"I couldn't protect Scar Man before, probably because the energy in the amulet ran out."
Thinking that this thing had a protective effect, Jiang Ping'an gritted his teeth and placed two more spiritual stones nearby.
The energy of the spirit stone has been consumed, but the jade pendant seems to have not been fully absorbed yet.
Jiang Ping'an didn't have many spiritual stones left, so he injected energy into Yu Perry from himself.
But after pouring all the energy in the body into it, it is still not filled.
"Bottomless pit!"
Jiang Pingan was particularly distressed.
It's better to absorb the energy from the sky and the earth and pour it slowly. There's no rush anyway.
At this moment, there was a sudden movement outside.
Jiang Ping'an suddenly picked up the knife and rushed out. A figure was running away at high speed.
He quickly picked up the knife and chased after him.
Probably a fellow bandit!
Never let the other party run away!
But after chasing for a long time, Jiang Ping'an still lost the pursuit.
